messages:
Maria: Quick sync — finalizing speaker handoff for the CloudEast joint webinar. We need: 1) who is doing the on-stage demo 2) swag courier ETA to venue 3) mic/badge distribution plan. @kevin @alesha
Kevin: I can take the on-stage demo + 10 minute walkthrough. Will rehearse with CloudEast on Wed. :thumbsup:
Alesha: I'll own swag and badges. Devin, can you confirm courier pickup window and whether we can do morning delivery to meet registration? @devin
Devin: Courier pickup confirmed for Tue 6pm PST. ETA to venue Wed 8am local. Tracking: TRACK123456789 (will update). We can do a backstage drop at 7:30am.
Alesha: Perfect. Do we have a list of names for attendee badges / speaker lanyards? I need a CSV by Monday COB.
Maria: I'll export attendee list from Eventbrite and DM it to you. Also need short 2-line speaker bios for the slide deck — can you ping CloudEast for that? @Kevin can you chase?
Kevin: On it. Will ping CloudEast PM and ask for bios and preferred demo CLI commands. Also scheduling a 30-min mic check Thu morning.
Alesha: For swag — two SKUs: t-shirts (S/M/L) and 50 USB-C sticker packs. Packing list:
```
- 150 T-shirts: sizes split 40/60/50
- 50 sticker packs
- 20 partner-branded dongles (spares)
``` 
Devin: Courier will require a customs invoice for the branded dongles. Alesha, can you attach HS codes? I'll add to label.
Alesha: Yep, HS: 8517.62 for dongles, will include invoice PDF in ship manifest.
SwagBot: Reminder: swag inventory low — reorder T-shirts size M (qty 100) and sticker stock (qty 200). :package:
Maria: Good catch. Let's do the reorder today so we have extras on-site. Kevin — confirm final demo artifact path we should stage on the demo laptop (local copy + fallback Docker image).
Kevin: Staging plan:
1) local model snapshot: /home/demo/models/cloudeast-v1
2) fallback: docker run -p 8080:8080 cloudeast/demo:fallback
I'll push final artifact to the shared drive by Tue noon.
Alesha: One more ask — do we want a small 'thank you' card in each swag bag with partner logos? I can draft and send for approvals.
Maria: Yes please — include logos and a QR to the partner signup form. Alesha send draft by Tue EOD. 
Devin: I'll deliver the manifest and courier ETA to venue contact @venue-ops and confirm backstage drop window.
Kevin: Rehearsal calendar invite sent to all speakers + AV team for Thu 9am local. Please accept.
Maria: Great. If anything slips, fallback plan is: demo recorded short clip (2m) + on-stage Q&A. Keep me posted. Thanks team! :rocket:
